title: JAX code to accompany the NeurIPS paper ["Learning Generalized Gumbel-max Causal Mechanism
summary: Builds counterfactual-simulation tooling on our JAX implementations of generalized Gumbel-max causal mechanisms - Gadget 1 and Gadget 2 - which learn couplings that make counterfactual estimates lower-variance than standard Gumbel-max baselines.
